svg.title: Performance relative to DNC
svg.desc: CPU eager and MPS compiled, shown in separate panels with shared logarithmic axes. Markers are medians of 20 paired byte-interface speedups against DNC T-table; horizontal bars are recorded 95% workload-bootstrap intervals from 2,000 resamples. The dashed reference is 1; the reference model is not an additional measured point. FP32, 32 messages of 16 blocks, one process, query protection disabled.

g.text: AES-128-CBC; FP32; 32 messages of 16 blocks; byte interface
Paired speedup relative to DNC T-table (log scale)
DNC T-table time / candidate time; values above 1 are faster, below 1 are slower.
20 pairs, one process; 95% bootstrap intervals, 2,000 resamples; DNC query protection disabled.
